# Subdirectories

* [activity](activity/index.md) — This area captures what connected project sources reveal about the current life of the application: active work, recurring themes, delivery flow, defects, maintenance pressure and repository activity.
* [apis](apis/index.md) — HTTP APIs, event APIs, GraphQL, SOAP, RPC or other public/internal contracts.
* [architecture](architecture/index.md) — Architecture notes, diagrams and decision records.
* [batchs](batchs/index.md) — Scheduled jobs, scripts, asynchronous workers, consumers, cron tasks or ETL jobs.
* [cicd](cicd/index.md) — This section documents delivery automation, pipeline status and recent repository activity.
* [domain](domain/index.md) — Business entities, concepts, states and lifecycle notes.
* [features](features/index.md) — Feature folders capture behavior that matters to the team.
* [integrations](integrations/index.md) — How the Orders Service sits in the information system.
* [roles](roles/index.md) — This section documents application roles, permissions and system actors.
* [screens](screens/index.md) — This area contains actionable deep dives for UI screens, views and page workflows.
* [services](services/index.md) — Internal modules, packages, services, bounded contexts or deployable units.
* [technical](technical/index.md) — Cross-cutting technical knowledge that does not belong to one feature.
